about: Corrections a person made after checking the page image. Keyed by source ID, then parser element ID. 'was' is the fingerprint of the element the correction was written against: if a new parse changes that element, the correction is not applied and the ingestion report asks for another look. 'reviewed_pages' lists the scanned pages checked against the image.
